user_instruction: Cite only 2021-2026 work in the manuscript; older works remain internal library references (instruction of 2026-11-03, superseding the earlier five foundational exceptions).

internal_reference_decisions.reason: Historical sliding-mode trajectory-tracking example; recent GP/MPC and uncertainty-aware tracking studies already support the comparison.
Historical social inverse-reinforcement-learning example; recent interaction prediction and social/semantic navigation studies support the current comparison.

excluded_background_reasons.B_LOAM2014: Historical estimator example; retain ORB-SLAM3 (2021) and FAST-LIO2 (2022) as recent representative baselines.
excluded_background_reasons.B_KITTI2012: Historical generic driving benchmark; use recent ground-robot datasets in the evaluation-resource comparison.
excluded_background_reasons.B_TUM2012: Historical generic RGB-D benchmark; use recent robot-specific dataset resources in the current comparison.
excluded_background_reasons.B_Habitat2019: Historical simulator citation; discuss simulation requirements through recent evaluated systems.
excluded_background_reasons.B_HumanAware2013: Historical human-aware navigation survey; current learned-navigation/foundation-model reviews and recent social-navigation studies cover the chosen scope.

foundational_exceptions.B_CBF2017: Control barrier function quadratic programs; attributes the CBF condition, Eq. (5).
foundational_exceptions.B_Cadena2016: SLAM formulation and robust-perception survey; attributes the estimation posterior, Eq. (4).
foundational_exceptions.B_Campion1996: Original structural classification of wheeled-robot kinematic models; attributes Eqs. (1)-(3).
foundational_exceptions.B_DWA1997: Original dynamic window approach; attributes the DWA definition in Sections I-II.
foundational_exceptions.B_GNSSIntegrity2018: GNSS integrity review; attributes alert limit, protection level and integrity risk, Eq. (6).
foundational_exceptions.B_Nav22020: Nav2 navigation system; attributes the deployed navigation-stack description in Section II.
foundational_exceptions.B_TEB2013: Original timed-elastic-band formulation; attributes the TEB definition in Sections I-II.

preservation: All indexed PDFs, publisher citations, transcriptions, review cards and historical acquisition selections remain unchanged; excluded background records stay in revision/background-sources/.
new_ieee_batch: 36 selected 2025-2026 IEEE papers (R01-R36), acquired, transcribed, read at targeted light level and cited in the manuscript (2026-11-03).
foundational_policy_2026_11_04: Author decision of 2026-11-04 after a simulated review: foundational pre-2021 sources are cited as background references for attribution of definitions and equations. They are outside the coded 2021-2026 corpus and its counts.
